Container.Name: nomyx-agent
Container.Overview: Nomyx monitoring agent. Runs the checks defined in its config.json and POSTs results to a Nomyx server. Has no web UI and exposes no ports — it only makes outbound connections. To monitor this Unraid host it needs the Docker socket (container count) and a read-only mount of /mnt/user (disk usage); CPU and memory it reads from /proc automatically. Put your config.json in the mapped /config folder before starting, with serverUrl and an agent token filled in.
Container.Description: Place a config.json in the mapped /config directory (serverUrl, an agent token from Nomyx Settings, and your checks). The Docker socket and /mnt/user mounts let the agent see the host's containers and disk usage.

Config.Name: Config Folder
Config.Description: Folder holding the agent's config.json (serverUrl, token, checks).

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Read-only Docker socket so the agent can count running containers via the Docker API.

Config.Name: Host Shares (read-only)
Config.Description: Read-only mount of the array so the disk-usage check can see real host usage.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path to config.json inside the container. Leave as default unless you rename the file.
